title: Developer handoff with procedural motion and executable renderer

request.text: hiện tại file json export ra đang gặp các vấn đề trên, hãy fix cho tôi, hoặc có giải cách hiển thị nào trên tool để t nắm rõ được các thông số

decision: Keep native settings JSON and fixed footer. Add a derived developer document as a schema-owned custom visualization value; include effective timing, reference motion samples, optical formulas and a self-contained runtime compiled from the same painter. Use native actions for clipboard spec and runnable HTML. Preserve accepted painter and do not add optional image/video export.
checks: Timing, static/ease/loop and schema unit checks
Focused native JSON export/import, clipboard and standalone renderer pixel parity in browser
Production build and stable Vercel bundle verification
risks: Sampled motion keyframes are reference data, not a replacement for the procedural renderer. Exact Canvas2D implementation is included.
